title: Prefix Lines
h1: Add Prefix and Suffix to Every Line — Free Online
seoTitle: Prefix Lines — Add Text to Start of Each Line
description: Add a custom prefix and optional suffix to every line of text. Perfect for turning lists into bullets, numbered items, comments or quoted lines. Browser-only and private.
intro: Paste a list and instantly add the same text to the beginning or end of every line. Great for formatting, commenting code or preparing data.
blurb: Add a prefix and optional suffix to every line of text — free and private.
howItWorks: Paste the lines you want to modify.
Enter the text that should appear at the start of each line (prefix) and, if wanted, at the end (suffix).
Press Apply. Empty lines receive the prefix and suffix as well.
Copy the formatted result. All work happens in your browser.
examples: Turn a plain list into a Markdown bullet list by prefixing each line with "- ".
Add "// " to the start of every line to comment out a block of code.
Wrap each line in quotes by using a prefix of '"' and a suffix of '"'.

faq.q: What if I leave the prefix blank?
faq.a: Lines will only receive the suffix. You can use either field independently.

faq.q: Does it affect the last line if it has no trailing newline?
faq.a: Yes. Every line, including the final one, receives the prefix and suffix.

faq.q: Can I use it for numbering?
faq.a: This tool adds a fixed string. For automatic numbering use a different utility or combine it with other text tools.
